resources.string: Keeps wake detection active while the phone is locked.
Local wake detection for your caffeine delay timer.
Notifies you when your caffeine delay window opens.

Android requires a small ongoing notification while the app watches for your wake-up. You can hide it without turning off caffeine alerts — open Wake monitoring below and turn off that channel or set it to Silent.
Setup needed for reliable wake detection
Without notifications, exact alarms, and a battery-optimization exemption, overnight unlock detection can miss your wake-up.
